Capital protection

ENFORCED

Risk sizing includes expected stop slippage and round-trip fees. Whole shares, capital capped at available equity. Gaps can exceed loss budgets.

No-trade filters

PRICE ONLY

Event dates are manual exclusions. No live news, calendar, spread, flow, or volatility-index feed is implied.

Non-negotiable simulation boundaries

01One simultaneous position per instrument run; SPY and QQQ are separate accounts, not a shared portfolio.

02No first-15-minute entries, no overnight holds, and no automatic direction flips within a session.

03Missing or malformed data blocks affected evidence. Conflicting same-bar stop and target resolves to the stop.

04No broker connection, order placement, options pricing, premium modeling, or credential collection.

HISTORICAL

Import stock OHLC

Replace the selected instrument with your own licensed 1-minute data. Include at least 15 complete sessions before the requested start.

Required headers: timestamp,open,high,low,close. Timestamp must include Z or UTC offset. No volume or options fields used.

Imported data remains in this tab and is included in the workspace JSON export. Reload restores bundled bars.

Session coverage & exclusions

One dataset. Four research runs.

Both instruments and both candidates use the current risk settings, date range, and filters. Each starts with its own capital.
